events.description: Chandler Bing says the caller is Chandler Bing.
Monica Geller says the caller is Chandler Bing and asks whether Chandler Bing is OK.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing is fine.
Joey Tribbiani says Chandler Bing is trapped in an ATM vestibule with Jill Goodacre.
Joey Tribbiani tells Chandler Bing to listen.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller has no idea what Chandler Bing just said.
Monica Geller says Chandler Bing just said something that Monica Geller could not understand.
Chandler Bing tells Monica Geller to put Joey Tribbiani on the phone.
Joey Tribbiani asks Chandler Bing what is happening.
Chandler Bing says the thought that Chandler Bing is trapped in an ATM vestibule with Jill Goodacre entered Chandler Bing's mind.
